helpIntro: Pick a guide and we'll walk you through it, one little step at a time.

welcome.title: The grand tour
welcome.hint: A one-minute stroll around the app

addEntry.title: Adding money in or out
addEntry.hint: Spent something? Got paid? Start here

money.title: Our money
money.hint: What you can spend, and what you saved

reports.title: Reading your reports
reports.hint: So… where did the money go?

hello.title: Hello there! 👋
hello.body: Let us show you around. It takes one minute, and you can escape any time with ✕.

spent.title: This month's damage 😅
spent.body: Everything you spent this month. Tap it to see where it all went.

money.title: Our money 💰
money.body: Two numbers: what you can spend now, and what you saved. Tap either one to look inside.

add.title: Meet the + button ⭐
add.body: Paid for something? Got some money? Tap +. You two will become good friends.

history.title: History 📖
history.body: Everything you ever wrote down lives here. Find any entry to fix or delete it.

reports.title: Reports 📊
reports.body: Friendly charts that show where your money goes, month after month.

help.title: Lost? Tap ? 🧭
help.body: This button is on every screen. Tap it whenever you want a guide again.

plus.title: It all starts with + ✨
plus.body: Tap + at the bottom of any screen. Come on, let's open it together.

type.title: Out or in? 🤔
type.body: Money out is for things you paid. Money in is for money you got. Move is for money going from one wallet to another.

amount.title: How much? 🔢
amount.body: Tap the big keys. Got a long receipt? Add it up right here, like 120 + 85.

category.title: What was it for? 🛒
category.body: Groceries? Bills? A little treat? Tap here and pick one.

details.title: Which wallet, which day 📅
details.body: Pick the wallet you paid from and the day. Today is already picked for you. Add a short note too, if you like.

save.title: Save it! ✅
save.body: Tap Save and you're done. Oops, a mistake? Tap Undo on the message that pops up.

toSpend.title: Ready to spend 💵
toSpend.body: Your cash and bank money. This is what you can pay with today.

saved.title: Put aside 🐷
saved.body: Money you saved for a goal or put into something like gold. It is not counted in your spending money.

tabs.title: Two sides 👀
tabs.body: Spending shows your cash and banks. Saving shows your goals and investments. Tap to switch.

goals.title: Saving goals 🎯
goals.body: Saving for a trip or a car? Tap New goal, then add a little whenever you can.

investments.title: Investments 🪙
investments.body: Gold is added by grams and karat, or add a bank certificate or anything you put money into. Tap Add investment to write it down.

value.title: What is it worth? 📈
value.body: Prices change. Open an investment and tap Update price, type today's price of one gram, and all your gold of that karat updates. Typed it wrong? Tap that line to change or remove it. It never touches your spending.

search.title: Detective mode 🔍
search.body: Type a word or an amount and we'll find the entry for you.

period.title: Time travel ⏳
period.body: Go back and forth in time. Tap the middle to see a day, a week, a month or a year.

filter.title: Just the ones you want 🎯
filter.body: Show only money out or money in, or just one category or wallet.

list.title: Tap to fix ✏️
list.body: Tap any entry to change or delete it. Deleted by accident? It waits in Settings for 30 days.

tabs.title: Three ways to look 👀
tabs.body: Overview is the quick summary. All reports has ready-made reports. Breakdown is the detailed table.

overview.title: Follow the money 🕵️
overview.body: Tap a slice of the chart or a category to see its entries. Swipe sideways for the last 6 months.

lists.title: Your lists 🗂️
lists.body: Categories, wallets, budgets and monthly entries: change them all here.

more.title: A few more things ⚙️
more.body: Switch between English and Arabic, or download a copy of your entries.

support.title: We're here for you 💬
support.body: Stuck on something? Write to us here, add a screenshot if you like, and we'll help.
